facts.value: Candidates can apply to the University of Limerick through the Central Applications Office (CAO).
Qualified candidates for all undergraduate degree courses are placed in order of merit based on a points system.
Applicants must be at least 16 years of age on the 15 January of the year of entry.
If a candidate below that age wishes to enter the University of Limerick, a special application must be made to the University via the Admissions Appeals Process.

Applicants are required to hold the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of six subjects including: Two H5 (Higher Level) grades, AND Four O6 (Ordinary Level) grades OR four H7 (Higher Level) grades.

Applicants are required to hold the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of five subjects including: Five O6 (Ordinary Level) grades, OR Five H7 (Higher Level) grades.
Candidates should see the relevant course page for course-specific entry requirements.
